scope: Adapted FreeSurfer 8.2 5TT, FSL FLIRT 6DOF and MRtrix iFOD2 ACT/SIFT2 versus current PyTorch on identical inputs within each raw/corrected condition
original_ukb_difference: Original UKB uses FreeSurfer 7.1, FIRST and 5ttgen freesurfer -first. Installed MRtrix 3.0.3 lacks -first, so these are adapted FreeSurfer 8.2 references. Both use a shared 20-region SynthSeg example atlas instead of the original cortical+Tian atlas.
seed_policy: MRTRIX_RNG_SEED=0, single-thread tckgen, 10000 attempts; PyTorch seeds 0/1/2, 10000 attempts each.
metric_policy: 20x20 strict upper triangle, count/FBC across 190 off-diagonal edges, length/FA values on edges with nonzero count in both arms.

raw.input_condition: raw AP DWI and original gradients
raw.registration: This condition's mean b0 to FreeSurfer brain.mgz with 6DOF normmi FLIRT; corrected arm recomputed FLIRT and transformed 5TT/GMWMI
raw.method: MRtrix default lmax8 MSMT-CSD/mtnormalise, iFOD2 -seed_gmwmi -act -seeds 10000 -select 0 -maxlength 250 -cutoff 0.1 -samples 3 -power 0.5, tcksift2, four tck2connectome -symmetric -assignment_radial_search 4 matrices

assignment.assignment_method: sum upper triangular including diagonal of symmetric count matrix

raw.timing_scope: Reuses existing FreeSurfer recon-all and MRtrix CSD; this is not a matched full-workflow speedup.

metric_policy.edge_subset: strict upper triangle; diagonal reported separately
metric_policy.length_fa_values: only edges with nonzero counts in both matrices
metric_policy.support: nonzero values of each metric; empty/empty Dice is 1
metric_policy.normalized_error: raw error / mean absolute nonzero reference value on evaluated edges
metric_policy.stability: all unordered candidate-directory pairs with the same comparison policy

corrected.input_condition: TOPUP/EDDY corrected AP DWI and EDDY-rotated gradients
corrected.registration: This condition's mean b0 to FreeSurfer brain.mgz with 6DOF normmi FLIRT; corrected arm recomputed FLIRT and transformed 5TT/GMWMI
corrected.method: MRtrix default lmax8 MSMT-CSD/mtnormalise, iFOD2 -seed_gmwmi -act -seeds 10000 -select 0 -maxlength 250 -cutoff 0.1 -samples 3 -power 0.5, tcksift2, four tck2connectome -symmetric -assignment_radial_search 4 matrices

assignment.assignment_method: sum upper triangular including diagonal of symmetric count matrix

corrected.timing_scope: Reuses existing FreeSurfer recon-all and MRtrix CSD; this is not a matched full-workflow speedup.

metric_policy.edge_subset: strict upper triangle; diagonal reported separately
metric_policy.length_fa_values: only edges with nonzero counts in both matrices
metric_policy.support: nonzero values of each metric; empty/empty Dice is 1
metric_policy.normalized_error: raw error / mean absolute nonzero reference value on evaluated edges
metric_policy.stability: all unordered candidate-directory pairs with the same comparison policy

release_gate.reason: The adapted FreeSurfer ACT reference still has substantial count/FBC normalized error and edge-support disagreement on matched corrected input.
